artifact_contract.final_document: a summary of durable facts, never their only copy
preserved_after: a runner crash, up to the last flushed record

build_identity.covers: every generated executable and fixture in the build directory at that moment
build_identity.kind_source: the ELF program headers, read directly rather than taken from file(1) or ldd(1) output text

journal.crash_semantics: a crash can lose only the record being written; a torn final line is dropped by the reader and reported, never repaired
journal.entered_vs_completed: case_entered is written before the case is posed and case_completed when its frozen status is final, so an abort names the last entered and the last completed case without a stack trace; an entered-not-completed case is never given a frozen status
journal.format: append-only JSONL, one record per line, flushed and fsynced
journal.immutability: no update and no delete; completing a case twice or completing one that was never entered raises

e5b_correction.case_semantics_unchanged: E5b remains mandatory with prediction Exited:0 and setup writer_open_closed
e5b_correction.claim_preserved: the writer is still opened O_WRONLY and is still closed before exec; the descriptor was NOT widened to O_RDWR, which would have changed what E5b tests
e5b_correction.short_transfer: a read or write of other than exactly one byte returns not_posed, which the frozen checker scores INVALID
e5b_correction.trial_001_defect: os.pwrite(fd, os.pread(fd, 1, 0), 0) on a descriptor opened O_WRONLY; a write-only file description carries no FMODE_READ, so read(2)/pread(2) return EBADF

host_information.why_by_key: a hostname is a short arbitrary token, so no length, entropy or shape rule can separate it from the kernel build string beside it; the field goes whole rather than being scanned

m3_t.bounded_claim: For the direct child in this candidate execution, the pidfd used by the launcher was returned through the CLONE_PIDFD facility of the SAME clone3 syscall that created that direct child, rather than being acquired later by pidfd_open() from a numeric PID.
claim_exclusions: the kernel implementation has been proved atomic
any general claim about pidfd behaviour beyond this one execution
any timing-sensitive normal-launch behaviour: M3 runs under a tracer, and its evidence is restricted to the acquisition facts below
m3_t.closure_form: REMOVED by R-2; absence of pidfd_open no longer proves which descriptor clone3 returned

evidence_facts.A: exactly one relevant candidate clone3 direct-child creation
evidence_facts.D: clone3 succeeds and returns the DIRECT_CHILD pid
evidence_facts.E: the tracer directly renders the pidfd produced by that clone3 call
evidence_facts.F: that pidfd equals the pidfd used by the launcher's direct-child lifecycle observation
evidence_facts.G: waitid(P_PIDFD, that_pidfd, ...) reports si_pid == the clone3 return
evidence_facts.H: no pidfd_open(DIRECT_CHILD_PID) acquisition path is observed

m3_t.self_assertion_rejected: no pidfd_acquisition receipt field exists in launcher_spike.c and the rule never reads one

publication_boundary.double_sanitisation: impossible by construction: run_trial returns its document RAW together with the sanitiser it built, and the boundary is the only place P-14 is applied
publication_boundary.invariant: json.dumps appears in exactly one place in the experiment, evidence.serialise, and no module other than evidence writes to stdout; both are asserted across the whole tree by AST, alongside behavioural tests over the real entry points
publication_boundary.m1_inherited: record() and serialise() each establish the fixed vocabulary first, so an unavailable driver vocabulary halts publication here too
publication_boundary.rule: no document reaches stdout without passing Sanitiser.record and serialise; sanitisation happens exactly once, at the boundary, never at a return site

requires: ONE bounded independent review of the Trial #2 corrections, then a NEW explicit owner D-7 authorisation and a NEW manual dispatch; this freeze is NOT a readiness statement and grants nothing
scope: Execution definition and disposable experiment sources frozen before the first preregistered LAUNCH-EXEC-01 trial. NOT_RUN: no trial has been executed and no case has been posed. D-7 (execution authorisation) is NOT granted.
supersession_reason: Trial #2 preregistration. Trial #1 executed freeze 89c923a, crossed the immutability boundary and aborted in E5b's fixture setup with EBADF, losing E1-E5's already-scored records because they lived only in memory; it is closed as TRIAL_ABORTED_AFTER_BOUNDARY with no derivable aggregate and its D-7 consumed. This freeze is a NEW preregistered trial, not a retry. Two corrections. E5b's setup no longer reads back through its write-only descriptor: the byte is read through a separate read-only descriptor that is closed before the writer opens, the writer stays O_WRONLY so the case's claim is unchanged, and a short transfer does not pose the case. Preservation is no longer deferred to the end: a new append-only journal flushes the preflight, the build identity and each case's final status as they happen, so an abort can lose only the record being written, and case_entered is distinguishable from case_completed. Build identity is hashed from the files on disk and made durable before the first case, the driver builds nothing, and the setups that open a pristine build product verify the digest at the point of use. The descriptor defect class was audited across every module and no other Python instance exists; one unreachable instance in launcher_spike.c is recorded and deliberately not fixed. No case membership, class, prediction, safe set, checker rule, M3 semantics, trace semantics, strace preflight or P-12 rule changed. No C source byte changed and Build 5 remains applicable. Trial #1, its freeze and its result review are preserved unchanged.

traced_cases.note: a syscall record is collected ONLY for these cases. R, T, O, P and S cases are never traced, because ptrace notifies the tracer before the real parent and those cases measure the launcher's own waitid classification.

tracer_requirement.fallback: none; the ptrace fallback the definition once promised is withdrawn
tracer_requirement.not_a_block_cause: tracer unavailability is never clone3_unavailable and never a conditional BLOCKED cause
tracer_requirement.on_failure: preflight HALT before the first preregistered case
tracer_requirement.statement: A usable strace >= 5.4 is a mandatory pretrial environment requirement. If strace is absent, older than the floor, or cannot render the trace contract the traced cases depend on, the runner HALTS before the first preregistered case. No ptrace, eBPF, helper-binary or root-requiring fallback exists or may be added for 0.1.

acquisition.cache_rule: only a complete validated snapshot is cached, as an immutable frozenset; failed and partial loads cache nothing, so no partially initialised import can poison the cache for the life of the process
acquisition.on_refusal: evidence.VocabularyUnavailable propagates out of Sanitiser.text, Sanitiser.record and serialise; no partially sanitised evidence is emitted and no empty vocabulary is substituted
acquisition.readiness_signal: driver.registry_vocabulary(), defined as the LAST statement of driver's module body, so its presence proves every registry is populated; a partially initialised driver simply does not have it
acquisition.recovery: the first call after the driver finishes initialising returns the complete vocabulary; verified from a fresh interpreter for every refused state above
refused_states: partially initialised driver with the registries absent
a required registry missing from the snapshot
a registry of the wrong type
a registry holding a value that is not a name
an accessor that is not callable or that raises
a snapshot that is not a mapping
acquisition.second_source_of_truth: none; the accessor returns the registries themselves
